title: GM aims to develop vehicles in as little as two years with AI, software push
hook_text: GM wants cars in two years
script:
General Motors is aiming to develop new vehicles in as little as two years.
General Motors is leveraging generative AI and digital design tools to overhaul its engineering pipeline.
Traditional vehicle development across the auto industry typically takes four to five years to complete.
The new software push aims to slash engineering bottlenecks and accelerate production cycles significantly.
By integrating these advanced tools, General Motors hopes to outpace legacy manufacturing timelines.
Would you buy a car designed in two years?
